name: axHub approvals
author: Brett
description: The hub's approvals inside the console: every request axHub has asked about (pending and held calls first), decided here through the console's hub-pages relay with a hub session, never the console token; one request's page with the complete call, history, postpone (time, date or condition) and every action it allows; held calls (veto@1) with the live countdown, Deny, Approve now and Shelve; the auto-approve window; the approvals log with calls that ran under a pass. Module axHub (the hub's own pages inside the console, folded from apps/axhub-web Nov 20 2026). Only a wall admin's browser may use it; uninstalling it removes only these pages.
